HOOK: Tired of stiff polyester replicas? Wear 100% authentic handloom cotton directly from Nadia weavers.

ENGLISH:
Handcrafted with airy 100-count pure cotton yarn, traditional temple border, and delicate floral butis. Drapes effortlessly and stays cool all day. Direct from artisan clusters to your doorstep.

বাংলা (BENGALI):
নদীয়ার ফুলিয়ার আসল তাঁতের শাড়ি — ১০০% সুতির শীতল স্পর্শ। ঐতিহ্যবাহী পাড় ও সুক্ষ্ম বুটির কাজে সাজিয়ে তুলুন আপনার প্রতিদিনের সাজ। আরামদায়ক ও আভিজাত্যপূর্ণ।

हिन्दी (HINDI):
पश्चिम बंगाल के फूलिया की असली हथकरघा तांत साड़ी। 100% शुद्ध सूती धागे से बुनी, बेहद हल्की और गर्मियों के लिए सर्वोत्तम।

products.targetRegion: Kolkata, West Bengal & Pan-India Regional Foodies

unknownFactors: Seasonal price volatility of Radhuni (wild celery seed) between monsoon and winter harvests in Bengal mandis.
scores.rankingRationale: Highest customer repeat rate among spice blends. Authentic Radhuni inclusion creates stark differentiation from commercial supermarket brands that substitute mustard.

costAssumptions: Supplier cost verified at Burrabazar Spices Wholesale Guild (Kolkata).
Selling price benchmarked against Amazon & Flipkart direct seller listings.
GST 5% output tax remitted to government, Input Tax Credit (ITC) recoverable on raw procurement.
Packaging in food-grade airtight PET jar with induction seal.

reviewInsights.summary: Authentic Radhuni inclusion provides true heirloom Bengali aroma.
reviewInsights.evidenceQuote: Most store-bought panch phoron uses yellow mustard instead of genuine Radhuni. Saarthi’s mix has real Radhuni and gives that unmistakable Maachher Jhol aroma.

reviewInsights.summary: Moisture ingress risk if seal is torn improperly during humid monsoon.
reviewInsights.evidenceQuote: In humid Kolkata weather the fenugreek and fennel can absorb moisture if the jar seal is damaged in courier transit.

reviewInsights.summary: Individual delivery fee on a single ₹175 item causes cart drop-off.
reviewInsights.evidenceQuote: The spice blend is superb, but paying ₹50 courier on a ₹175 bottle is painful. Better to bundle 3 bottles together for free shipping.

reviewInsights.summary: Express 48-hour delivery in Kolkata metro; 4-5 days to southern India.
reviewInsights.evidenceQuote: Delivered in Behala within 2 days. For Bangalore delivery it took 5 days via Delhivery Surface.

reviewInsights.summary: Customers demand pre-roasted ready-to-crush "Bhaja Moshla" variant.
reviewInsights.evidenceQuote: Can you also launch a roasted powdered version of this for sprinkling on Ghugni, Alur Dom and Chatpati?

sources.observedFacts: Raw cumin at ₹240/kg, fennel at ₹160/kg, fenugreek at ₹85/kg, nigella at ₹195/kg, radhuni at ₹480/kg. Blended cost per 250g is ₹48-₹55.
sources.limitations: Mandis rates fluctuate weekly based on seasonal arrivals from Gujarat and Bengal fields.

sources.observedFacts: Search interest maintains stable baseline index of 68 throughout year with peaks during Puja festival.
sources.limitations: Indicates consumer search appetite; does not guarantee e-commerce cart completion.

sources.observedFacts: Leading 250g brands retail between ₹165 and ₹249 with average customer rating of 4.3/5 across 1,400+ reviews.
sources.limitations: Competitor sales velocity estimated via rank and review velocity rather than direct internal ledger.
